style: Use case: stylized-concept. Finished enemy portrait for the dark fantasy deckbuilder Panlibrarium, matching painterly oil and gouache card paintings. Rich textured brushwork, aged brass, ink, dramatic chiaroscuro, restrained luminous magic, sophisticated fantasy book illustration. Landscape 3:2. ONE dominant subject fills central 70 percent; face in central upper third, important anatomy within frame, large strong silhouette readable at 150 pixels. Background atmospheric and less detailed than subject. No text, no typography, no words, no numbers, no frame, no UI, no watermark. Non-graphic fantasy, no blood or injuries. Human characters adults and fully clothed in armor or layered opaque robes.

biomes.LIBRARY: Ancient impossible library, midnight indigo ink and amber candlelight, quills and books become tangible magic.
biomes.VIKING: Mythic Norse world, icy fjords, weathered iron, pale blue northern light and ember amber; Scandinavian saga atmosphere.
biomes.GREEK: Mythic ancient Greek world, marble, bronze, laurel, Mediterranean azure and warm white stone; epic classical atmosphere.
biomes.EGYPTIAN: Mythic ancient Egyptian world, sandstone, lapis lazuli, gold, papyrus, turquoise magic and desert light.
biomes.LOVECRAFTIAN: Cosmic horror drowned library, impossible stone geometry, dark teal, eerie muted violet and sea green. Dread rather than gore.
biomes.AZTEC: Mythic Mesoamerican fantasy world, obsidian, jade, stepped stone temples, quetzal feathers, sun gold against deep jungle green.
biomes.CELTIC: Mythic Celtic world, ancient oak woodland, mist, moss, bronze, knotwork, luminous pale green and warm manuscript gold.
biomes.RUSSIAN: Slavic folklore world, snowbound birch forest, carved timber, frost silver and cold cobalt with ember red; medieval fairy-tale atmosphere.
biomes.AFRICAN: Mythic West African inspired fantasy world, baobab groves, woven cloth, carved wood, bronze, indigo and warm ochre, dignified oral storytellers and ancestral magic.

subjects.chapter_guardian: A towering sentinel made of layered ancient book covers and brass clasps, broad armored shoulders, luminous indigo slit in its helmet, monumental shield shaped like a closed codex. Full coherent guardian, one central silhouette.
subjects.the_archivist: An imposing corrupted archivist in layered midnight robes, elderly face partly shadowed by a hood, ink-black fingers controlling two hovering ornate inkwells, an enormous chained ledger. Ink filaments, not lettering.
subjects.fenrir: A colossal charcoal grey wolf with icy blue eyes, windblown fur and fractured golden magical chains across its shoulders, jaws snarling without blood. Clearly a wolf, huge weight and menace.
subjects.hel_queen: Hel the queen of a frozen underworld, regal fully clothed woman in layered black fur and silver armor, half of her face pale moonlit and half in deep shadow, frost crown, icy throne silhouettes. No decay or wounds.
subjects.medusa: Medusa, regal fully clothed bronze-armored gorgon queen with a crown of distinct living serpents, luminous green eyes, stone fragments suspended around her. Strong central face, coiled lower silhouette.
subjects.hydra_aspect: An enormous coherent many-headed emerald hydra rising from a Greek marsh, five long serpentine necks attached to one massive scaled body. Central head dominant, side heads inside the frame. Bronze-green scales.
subjects.ra_avatar: A monumental falcon-headed avatar of Ra, lapis and gold ceremonial armor covering the body, blazing circular sun halo, staff of solar fire, spread mantle. Strong falcon head and central silhouette.
subjects.osiris_judgment: Osiris as a majestic fully wrapped and fully clothed judge of the dead, dark green stone face, white and gold robes, tall crown, crossed crook and flail, turquoise scales of judgment glowing behind him.
subjects.nyarlathotep_shard: An impossible tall faceless cosmic emissary in layered black and violet robes, crown of curved tendrils, a starless void where the face should be, long elegant arms surrounded by warped stone arches. No real-world religious symbols.
subjects.shub_spawn: A huge eldritch woodland beast with multiple sturdy root-like legs, shaggy bark and dark moss, branching antlers and luminous pale eyes, emerging from a drowned impossible forest. Cosmic dread, no exposed flesh or gore.
subjects.tezcatlipoca_echo: A majestic obsidian-armored sorcerer with jaguar features, a polished round smoking obsidian mirror on the chest, turquoise ornaments and black feather mantle. One clear figure surrounded by silver smoke.
subjects.quetzalcoatl_wrath: A vast feathered serpent deity, jade-scaled coils and brilliant green and gold quetzal plumage, one powerful serpent head, great feathered wings, storm clouds over a stepped temple. All key anatomy inside composition.
subjects.dagda_shadow: A massive fully clothed Celtic giant in mossy wool and bronze armor carrying a huge wooden club, a luminous bronze cauldron at his side, ancient oak forest. Warm gold magic and deep green shadows.
subjects.cernunnos_shade: A tall forest sovereign with magnificent branching stag antlers, face half veiled in moss and shadow, layered bark armor and a bronze torc, spectral deer silhouettes in mist. Strong symmetrical silhouette.
subjects.baba_yaga_hut: Baba Yaga's ancient carved timber hut standing on TWO huge bird legs, crooked roof and glowing amber windows, snowbound birch forest; walking toward the viewer. Whole hut and feet visible, architectural creature.
subjects.koschei_deathless: A gaunt immortal Slavic king in fully enclosing blackened armor and heavy embroidered cloak, bone-like silver mask and narrow crown, icy sword, red-gold immortal light in the breastplate. No wounds.
subjects.soundiata_spirit: A dignified majestic West African ancestral warrior king, dark skin, fully clothed in richly woven indigo cloth and ornate bronze armor, strong lion-shaped golden spirit behind his shoulders, grounded commanding stance.
subjects.anansi_weaver: A giant mythic spider trickster with eight coherent articulated legs, dark lacquered body with bronze geometric markings, intelligent amber eyes, threads of golden light woven across a baobab grove. Actual spider, no human torso.
